gloss: clamor; noise; din; hustle and bustle

definitions.gloss: clamor; noise; din; hustle and bustle
definitions.explanation: Loud, chaotic noise typically associated with busy places or crowds of people.

examples.japanese: {都会|とかい}の{喧噪|けんそう}から{逃|に}げたい。
examples.english: I want to escape from the noise of the city.

examples.japanese: {喧噪|けんそう}を{離|はな}れて{静|しず}かな{場所|ばしょ}で{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: I rested in a quiet place away from the hustle and bustle.

examples.japanese: {祭|まつ}りの{喧噪|けんそう}の{中|なか}で{子供|こども}たちが{走|はし}り{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: Children were running around amid the clamor of the festival.

notes:
{喧噪|けんそう} describes loud, chaotic noise, especially in urban or crowded settings.

WORD FORMATION:
- {喧|けん} (noisy) + {噪|そう} (clamor, noise)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {都会|とかい}の{喧噪|けんそう}: city noise/bustle
- {喧噪|けんそう}を{離|はな}れる: to get away from the noise
- {喧噪|けんそう}から{逃|に}げる: to escape the hustle and bustle
- {喧噪|けんそう}の{中|なか}: amid the clamor

RELATED WORDS:
- {騒音|そうおん}: noise (more technical, often unwanted)
- {静寂|せいじゃく}: silence (opposite)
- {喧騒|けんそう}: variant writing (same meaning)
